build.buildCommand: pnpm install && sed -i 's/provider = "sqlite"/provider = "postgresql"/' packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma && pnpm --filter @repo/db exec prisma generate && pnpm --filter api build

deploy.startCommand: pnpm --filter @repo/db exec prisma migrate deploy && pnpm --filter @repo/db seed || true; pnpm --filter api start
